Actually @vvo, the second version with `searchParameters` doesn't work as expected when you have enabled `urlSync`: https://jsfiddle.net/JanPetr/pw2s7zcw/3/

Try to switch category to "VIP" and then remove the "VIP" category by clicking on it again in `hierarchicalWidget`. Instead of just removing the category from refinements, it'll return back the "Shirt" category:
![4wxwmji5ta](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/1058144/21913036/a35a305a-d8de-11e6-8fdd-2ff0d500c9af.gif)

Is that expected? Is it bug and should be fixed?
